recipes.oracle_text:
When Oath of Jace enters, draw three cards, then discard two cards.
At the beginning of your upkeep, scry X, where X is the number of planeswalkers you control.

mechanism.clause: When Oath of Jace enters, draw three cards, then discard two cards.
gaps: At the beginning of your upkeep, scry X, where X is the number of planeswalkers you control.

recipe_coverage: Actual entry draw/discard or optional-loot clause, both controllers, exact ordinary costs and owned zone/card conservation, ordered library receipts and legal AI discard subsets, empty/uneven hands, normal countering/source removal/re-entry and snapshot replay. Other complete printed clauses remain explicit gaps; enchantments retain their actual noncreature type.
